x: Held on the same day as the above fixture, as owing to the club "Open" walk, no runners are allowed at Wimbledon, our vice-captain Bert Smith took along a mixed team to run against the local club at Perivale. Arthur Bruce was our first man home in second position, with Con Abberton 6, Bert Footer 7, Bert Smith 8, K.
Eddie Short lost a shoe but pluckily kept going and Archie Bedford came through to finish a good fourth. Jack Shields and Ken England were also well up and a new member in J.
Harry Greene 1st in the Inter Schools race for the Densham Cup. Ken England and Jim Kennedy on their recent marriages.

Many members will remember Ken England, a rather tough determined cross-country runner of a few years back. Ginger Kennedy writes to tell us that Ken is a very ill man, now hardly able to walk due to disseminated schlerosis.
